## ASD Essential Eight: Application control

Measures App Control for Business (formerly Windows Defender Application Control / WDAC) enforcement coverage, audit-only devices, blocked executions, user-profile executions and vulnerable driver blocklist events using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint telemetry (`DeviceEvents`, `DeviceProcessEvents`, `DeviceInfo`, `DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment`).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) summary:**
- **ML1**: Application control enforced on workstations restricting execution from user-writable locations.
- **ML2**: Extended to internet-facing servers, Microsoft recommended block rules and vulnerable driver blocklists enabled, execution events centrally logged.
- **ML3**: Enforced across all workstations and all servers using cryptographic hash, publisher certificate or immutable path rules.

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model) and [Query App Control events with advanced hunting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/application-security/application-control/app-control-for-business/operations/querying-application-control-events-centrally-using-advanced-hunting).

parameters.name: DeviceGroup
parameters.label: Device group
parameters.query:
DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| distinct GroupName
| order by GroupName asc

content.title: App Control for Business (WDAC) KPI summary

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, DeviceType, IsInternetFacing, OSPlatform) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}))
| extend ScopeBucket = case(
    DeviceType =~ 'Workstation', 'Workstations (ML1+)',
    IsInternetFacing == true, 'Internet-Facing Servers (ML2+)',
    'Internal Servers (ML3)'
);
let acState = DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ActionType startswith 'AppControl'
| summarize Blocked = countif(ActionType has 'Blocked'), Audited = countif(ActionType has 'Audited') by DeviceId
| extend PolicyMode = case(Blocked > 0, 'Enforced (Blocking)', Audited > 0, 'Audit Only', 'Other AppControl Event');
devices
| join kind=leftouter acState on DeviceId
| extend PolicyMode = coalesce(PolicyMode, 'No AppControl Telemetry')
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceId) by ScopeBucket, PolicyMode
| order by ScopeBucket asc, Devices desc
content.title: Enforcement coverage by Essential Eight asset scope (ML1 workstations, ML2 internet-facing servers, ML3 all servers)

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, DeviceType, IsInternetFacing) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ActionType in ('AppControlCodeIntegrityPolicyBlocked', 'AppControlCodeIntegrityPolicyAudited', 'AppControlExecutableBlocked', 'AppControlExecutableAudited', 'AppControlCodeIntegrityDriverRevoked', 'AppControlCodeIntegrityImageRevoked')
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| extend Fields = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| extend PolicyName = tostring(Fields.PolicyName), PublisherName = tostring(Fields.PublisherName)
| summarize EventCount = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceId), SampleDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 5), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by ActionType, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, PublisherName, PolicyName
| order by EventCount desc
| take 100
content.title: Top blocked, audited and revoked App Control execution events

content.query:
let devices = DeviceInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, MachineGroup, DeviceType) by DeviceId, DeviceName
| extend GroupName = iff(isempty(MachineGroup), 'Unassigned', MachineGroup)
| where ('*' in ({DeviceGroup}) or GroupName in ({DeviceGroup}));
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where FolderPath has_any ('\\Users\\', '\\AppData\\', '\\Temp\\', '\\Downloads\\', '\\ProgramData\\')
| where FileName endswith '.exe' or FileName endswith '.scr' or FileName endswith '.com' or FileName endswith '.bat' or FileName endswith '.ps1'
| join kind=inner devices on DeviceId
| summarize Executions = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceId), SampleAccounts = make_set(AccountName, 5) by FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, GroupName
| order by Devices desc, Executions desc
| take 100
content.title: Executions from user-writable directories (E8-AC-ML1-02 gap check)
